There's nothing.|[[Comet (clone trooper)|Comet]]|}} The '''Oba Diah moon''' was a [[desert]] [[moon]] that [[orbit]]ed the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]]. Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Pyke Syndicate]] shot down [[Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas]]'s [[775519|shuttle]] over the moon. The crash site was rediscovered when the [[shuttle]]'s [[distress signal]] led [[Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon]] and the [[104th Battalion]] to the Oba Diah moon during the [[Clone Wars]]. ==Description== {{Quote|I see cliffs, yes. I think?''"
"''Well, the rest of the planet is as smooth as an Umbaran's scalp.|[[RZ-7]] and [[Karr Nuq Sin]]|''[[Force Collector]]''}} The Oba Diah [[moon]] was a barren [[desert]] moon in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]]. It was frequently ravaged by severe [[sandstorm]]s, which made travel difficult due to the blowing sand and nonexistent visibility. ==History== ===Death of Sifo-Dyas=== The Oba Diah moon was controlled by the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. In [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' former [[Jedi]] [[Jedi High Council|Council]] member [[Sifo-Dyas]] and [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]'s [[aide]] [[Silman]]'s [[T-6 shuttle|T-6]] [[775519|shuttle]] was [[Mission to Oba Diah (Sifo-Dyas)|shot down]] by the [[Pyke]]s on the orders of a [[Gender|man]] named [[Dooku|Tyranus]]. Sifo-Dyas was [[Death|killed]] in the crash, but Silman survived. The Pykes then left the [[shuttle]], taking Sifo-Dyas's body to Tyranus and Silman as insurance for the future. ===Clone Wars=== [[File:CometInTheSand-TLO.png|thumb|right|300px|The 104th Battalion comb the desert]] {{Quote|We've scanned the area three times. This is a wasteland. There's nothing.|Comet, searching for the source of the distress signal|}} Near the end of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] detected a [[distress signal]] coming from the moon. [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] was [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)|sent]] to investigate, along with [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Wolffe]] and the [[104th Battalion]]. After a difficult search through a severe sandstorm, Plo and his forces eventually located the shuttle. Searching the wreckage, Plo found Sifo-Dyas' [[Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. The suspicious discovery led Plo to order the area cleared and all of the wreckage be collected for transport to [[Coruscant]]. Subsequently, [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent to Oba Diah to investigate, discovering the Pykes' involvement in Sifo-Dyas' murder and Silman in their dungeon, as well as the identity of Tyranus: [[Count]] Dooku, a [[Sith Lord]], fallen Jedi Master, and the [[Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. ==Behind the scenes== The Oba Diah moon first appeared in "[[The Lost One]]," a [[2014]] episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-lost-one-episode-guide|text="The Lost One" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places Oba Diah in the [[Kessel system]], and ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'' places it on the [[Pabol Sleheyron]].''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'' However, later maps created by [[Christopher Ibbitt]] and [[Jason Fry]], such as the one in ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' and the [[2025]] [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]], and its "[[Star Systems of the
